Full sweep completed: read all 1,020 lines of the supplied landed diff against protected main edbcfef98e60b4863afdd698f495c295e85bb129 (landed tree 49ee5d6b5fb57f15bded40cbd01f96a52d027dc7), attesting only original PR head 9a5e5cc6b33ab4e0b641d1d1e4c63b9ba4997815. Covered spec BUG-2699 resolves through AIDA to BUG-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-463. It has no formal Acceptance section; every requested behavior follows.
AC1 Load pending briefs for the spec into the Codex lane prompt: unverified. Normal generated briefs are wired through queue work, Codex rendering and fresh launch paths, but round-suffixed filenames without frontmatter are silently omitted (finding 1).
AC2 Mark delivered briefs consumed: unverified. The acknowledgement has a replacement race (finding 2) and the native headless callback precedes a fallible handoff that can kill the worker (finding 3).
AC3 Add explicit queue work --brief FILE: verified by source evidence in queue_cmd_args.rs, queue_cmd/work.rs and PickupBrief::read_explicit/pickup_briefs, including scope checks, incompatible modes and preservation of external files; regression declarations cover these cases.
AC4 Regression: a Codex lane launched with a pending brief has its text in the prompt: verified by source evidence in session/inline_tests.rs::bug_2699_codex_child_receives_and_acknowledges_pending_briefs, which runs a fake Codex child, inspects argv, checks multiple briefs and exclusions, and checks failed-spawn retention/successful-spawn acknowledgement. The spec reports 65 passing lane tests; this review did not independently run them.
Optional advisor suggestion to add check-store-writers.py to the default pre-push checklist: not-applicable-because the suggestion was conditional on a natural fit and this diff changes no such checklist.
Existing exact-head CI run 44467024634 is successful: fast gates, fast compile (workspace/tests check), Ratchet set, and Build aggregate; full test shards were skipped. No local builds or tests were run under reviewer policy. The reviewed absolute CodeGraph client is absent; callers were checked with rg. The head is two commits behind the pinned base; none of these findings depends on code changed by those base commits. Three actionable blocking findings follow.
